title: HS60024: Leadership
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Course ContentLeadership: leadership in corporate, society, science and
technology, who is leader and what does it mean to be leader; Theories: trait,
behavioural, contingency/ situational; Power, politics, networking, negotiation
and leadership effectiveness; Charismatic, transformational and ethical
leadership; trust and leadership; Team-based leadership, on-line leadership;
Leadership, culture, diversity and learning organisation; Effective leadership.
